summary: Coalition task force formed under UN Security Council Resolution 2841 to restore Gorgan sovereignty and deter further Donovian aggression. CJTF Commander: Lt Gen Sandra Park, USAF. JFACC: Brig Gen Michael Torres, USAF. Seven nations contributing air assets.

fullName: Brig Gen Michael Torres, USAF — Joint Force Air Component Commander
summary: Commands all coalition air operations from the AOC at Atropian Air Base. Has 48 hours to stand up the AOC and execute the first ATO. Operates under strict ROE — collateral damage is a strategic concern.

Now occupying the Zabzimek Corridor inside Gorgas following the 58th Combined Arms Army cross-border operation. IADS active. EW jamming coalition communications along the border. Continues IO and cyber pressure on Gorgas.
Contributing 24 F-16C/D fighters and a small modern force to the coalition. The JFLCC (Joint Force Land Component Commander) is Maj Gen Aram Petrosyan, Gorgan Army.
Hosts the Coalition AOC at Atropian Air Base. Contributing 12 Su-30SM fighters.
Donovian-language separatist enclave inside Gorgas, now seized by Donovian 58th Combined Arms Army. The principal objective for the coalition air campaign.

fullName: France, UK, Poland, UAE, Gorgas, Atropia, plus contributing nations
summary: Seven nations contributing air assets to CJTF-CAU. France deploying 6 Rafales to Atropian Air Base. UK, Poland, UAE also contributing fighter and support aircraft.

fullName: USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group · JFMCC
summary: On station in the Caspian Sea with 24 F/A-18E/F Super Hornets. JFMCC: Rear Adm James Kowalski, USN. NALE coordinates carrier air wing integration with the AOC.
